title: 第18章 梦境记忆第19章 亲你知道古武吗
content_zh:
“哪位白小姐？”
小王看着旁边神色不耐的昊少，紧张的问道。
“就是坐在车上的这位呀。”
小维看着小王的脸色，一脸的莫名其妙。
怎么可能！小王脑海里第一个想法就是难以置信！
这两人不就是些刚进城的乡巴佬么，城里的上流人士他有哪个没见识过，即便是没见过，也大多会有他们店的会员，毕竟全城目前也就他们的专卖店进货渠道广，种类最全，还可享受高级的vip服务。
再看看这两人，既没有vip会员，貌似也没听过他们店的名声，而且衣服款式老旧不说，那质量一看就知道不只是哪儿买的地摊货色，这能是什么有钱人？就算是暴发户也不是这样的吧？
“小维，你是不是哪里搞错了？他们根本就没有钱，纯粹就是来捣乱的，你可别被他们两个给忽悠了。”
说着小王畏畏缩缩的躲在昊少身后，看了看白月的脸色，害怕她再次出手教训他。
但转眼看到昊少一脸阴霾的表情，顿时心里有些打鼓，却还是硬着头皮道：“现在是省城的唐小姐要买这辆车，你赶紧的去把手续办好了，不然搞砸了让你吃不了兜着走！”
小维看着这盛气凌人的小王也有些怒了，不过碍于老板对他处处维护的脸面，也只好忍下这口气。
还是公事公办的说道：“白小姐已经付过账了，而且相关手续我也已经给她办齐了，你让我怎么把卖出去的车要回来？”
“卖？卖了？真的卖了？”
小王顿时感觉如坠冰窟，傻眼得一张嘴长大得下巴都要掉到地上去，只觉得一个头两个大，这下可怎么跟唐小姐交代啊！
一直没有做声的唐小姐此时脸上也染上了怒意，瞪着这销售小王道：“所以你们现在是联合在一起来耍我吗？我很忙的，没时间陪你们这些人玩！”
说着，戴回了自己的墨镜，丢下了一句：“我看这家破店，也没必要再开了！”
便趾高气昂的走了。
“哎哎哎！！唐小姐！唐小姐！这只是个误会！误会啊！唐小姐！您别..别走...”
销售小王感觉自己真是混得到头了，如果这家店真的被唐家给弄倒闭了，他的老板表哥可不得把他皮都给扒了！
就算是死皮赖脸跑着趴着跪着哭丧着脸，都要求得唐小姐的原谅。

看着自作孽遭报应的小王，小维心里顿时觉得一阵畅快，但转念想着唐小姐的话，心里又有了担忧。
看出了小维内心的担忧，正在签交付合同的白月看着她的眼睛笑着说道：“我说过，你可以随时打那个电话的，只要你愿意。”
“啊？”
正在发呆思考出路的小维听到白月这话，顿时有些受宠若惊。
若是在刚开始她收到这张卡片的时候，她的确是无动于衷的，甚至都没把这当回事。但是自这位白小姐拿出黑卡的那一瞬，她才隐隐知道这位背后的能量到底有多大，也不近生出了一丝敬畏，还有丝许的期待。
“好，我会好好考虑的。”
小维朝着白月点了点头，说道。
“嗯，这合同我已经签好了，应该没有其他什么手续要办了吧？”
白月盖上了合同，递交一份给了小维。
“没有了，白小姐，这是您的车钥匙。”
小维将口袋里崭新的钥匙恭恭敬敬的递给了白月。
“不用给我，我给你填个地址，你直接让人把车送到这个地址就可以了。”
白月从小背包里拿出了纸笔，快速的写下祝言家的地址就递给了小维，便带着云风走了。
“嗯~还是外面的空气舒服多了。”
content_en:
"Which Miss Bai?"
Xiao Wang looked at Mr. Hao who looked impatient next to him and asked nervously.
"That's the one sitting in the car."
Xiaowei looked at Xiaowang's face with a puzzled expression.
How is that possible! The first thought in Xiao Wang's mind was unbelievable!
Aren't these two people just country bumpkins who have just arrived in the city? There is no upper class person in the city that he has not met before. Even if he has never met, most of them are members of their store. After all, their store is the only store in the city with the widest purchasing channels and the most complete varieties, and they can also enjoy high-end VIP services.
Look at these two people again. They have no VIP membership and have never heard of the reputation of their store. Not to mention the old style of their clothes, but the quality shows that they are not just street stall goods bought from somewhere. What kind of rich man can this be? Even the nouveau riche are not like this, right?
"Xiaowei, did you make a mistake somewhere? They have no money at all and are just here to cause trouble. Don't let them fool you."
As he spoke, Xiao Wang shrank and hid behind Mr. Hao, looking at Bai Yue's face, fearing that she would teach him a lesson again.
But in the blink of an eye, when I saw the gloomy expression on Mr. Hao's face, I suddenly felt a little nervous, but I still had to bite the bullet and said: "Miss Tang from the provincial capital wants to buy this car now. You should hurry up and complete the procedures, otherwise you will be left with nothing to eat!"
Xiaowei was a little angry when he saw the domineering Xiao Wang, but because his boss always maintained his face, he had to endure it.
Still businesslike, he said: "Ms. Bai has already paid the bill, and I have completed all the relevant procedures for her. How do you want me to get the car back?"
"Sold? Sold? Really sold?"
Xiao Wang suddenly felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave. He was so dumbfounded that his mouth grew so big that his chin almost fell to the ground. He only felt that one head was as big as two. How could he explain to Miss Tang now?
Miss Tang, who had been silent all this time, now had anger on her face. She glared at the little sales king and said, "So are you joining forces to play tricks on me now? I'm very busy and don't have time to play with you guys!"
After saying that, he put on his sunglasses and said: "I don't think there is any need to open this shabby store again!"
Then he walked away proudly.
"Hey, hey, hey!! Miss Tang! Miss Tang! This is just a misunderstanding! Misunderstanding! Miss Tang! Don't... don't leave..."
The salesman felt that he was really screwed up. If this store was really bankrupted by the Tang family, his boss's cousin would have to peel off his skin!
Even if he ran around shamelessly, knelt down and cried, he still asked for Miss Tang's forgiveness.
Seeing Xiao Wang getting retribution for his own sins, Xiao Wei suddenly felt relieved, but then thinking about Miss Tang's words, he felt worried again.
Seeing Xiao Wei's inner worries, Bai Yue, who was signing the delivery contract, looked into her eyes and said with a smile, "I said, you can make that call at any time, as long as you want."
"Huh?"
Xiao Wei, who was in a daze thinking about a way out, was flattered when he heard Bai Yue's words.
When she first received this card, she was really indifferent and didn't even take it seriously. But from the moment Miss Bai took out the black card, she had a vague idea of ​​how powerful the energy behind this person was, and she soon felt a sense of awe and a little bit of expectation.
"Okay, I will think about it carefully."
Xiaowei nodded towards Bai Yue and said.
"Well, I have already signed this contract. There shouldn't be any other procedures to go through, right?"
Bai Yue stamped the contract and handed one copy to Xiaowei.
"No more, Miss Bai, here are your car keys."
Xiaowei handed the brand new key in his pocket to Bai Yue respectfully.
"No need to give it to me, I'll fill in an address for you, and you can just have the car delivered to this address."
white moonHe took out a pen and paper from his small backpack, quickly wrote down the address of Zhu Yan's house, handed it to Xiao Wei, and left with Yunfeng.
"Hmm~ The air outside is much more comfortable."
